name: Singlife One Clark International Marathon
short_description: A full marathon held on September 20, 2026, at Clark Parade Grounds, Clark Freeport, Pampanga, Philippines, organized by RUNRIO Inc.
ai_summary: The Singlife One Clark International Marathon is a full-marathon event scheduled for September 20, 2026, at the Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga, Philippines.
